answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the vine until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round.
